order_param_is_memory_copy.meaning: the order parameter passed to _updateLimitPostOrder is a memory variable (temporary copy), not storage

previous_tail_exists.meaning: a previous tail order exists in the limit price level to which the new order is being linked

new_order_stored_prev_order_id.meaning: stored prevOrderId of the new order after linking (the backward pointer persisted in storage)

previous_tail_order_id.meaning: identifier of the previous tail order that the new order must point backward to in storage

cancellation_targets_wrong_order.meaning: a cancellation attempt affects an order other than the intended one
cancellation_targets_wrong_order.checkpoint: during cancellation after the broken backward link

assumptions: The new order is linked into the limit price level whose previous tail order is previous_tail_order_id.
Cancellation of an order relies on the doubly-linked list pointers, so a broken backward pointer can redirect cancellation to a different order.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the concrete order identifiers or how cancellation selects an order from the list, so the exact wrong-order target cannot be bound numerically.

limitations: The selected impact is potential; the plan encodes only the report-supported conditional scenario in which a broken backward link leads a cancellation attempt to affect a wrong order.
Order identifiers are symbolic; no concrete values are supplied by the report.
Other reported impacts (reverse traversal failure, orphaned orders, head reassignment, loss of preceding orders, unfillable orders, inaccurate accounting) are not formalized by this plan.
